plain_language.what_did_we_find: Provisional: early runner review found missing input-byte custody checks, incomplete smoke-evidence rechecking, and automatic sequence stopping before the required independent limit diagnosis. Four existing launch tests do not cover baseline or control-failure stops. No selected terms or observers have run.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes, as preparation engineering. These controls prevent changed inputs or incomplete evidence from becoming scientific observations and preserve the distinction between real limits and control failures.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Repair and test the launch controller, add exact limit-review/resume handling, and complete portable receipt coverage before execution freeze or launch.

findings.observed: Initial _profile_run read input before launch but bound the path only afterward; actual read bytes were not compared to the sealed expectation.
findings.required: Use exact expected binding; verify read bytes and path before launch, after launch, and Nanoda stdin accounting. Retain raw process evidence and explicit custody failure before raising.

findings.observed: Scientific gate checked result/attempt-result hashes but omitted the referenced raw smoke streams, receipts and inputs.
findings.required: Check all referenced committed bindings and replay expected smoke dispositions before science.

findings.required: Preserve the triggering cell and pause; bind an independent PASS_FOR_SEQUENCE_STOP review before resuming unrun slots and recording dependent NOT_RUN_AFTER_LIMIT rows.

findings.observed: Existing tests cover stale smoke contract, changed corpus file, a mocked missing gate and one valid-limit matrix. They omit baseline/control-fault immediate-stop and raw-failure retention.
findings.required: Add disjoint synthetic baseline and science-control failures proving preserved ledger/raw/failure and no later invocation; add completed-attempt guards and exact prior-prefix custody for resumption.

findings.required: Cover all preserved preflight and process attempts, compare declared/discovered receipt membership, allow null exit only for explicit fault evidence, and prove foreign-checkout replay makes no process launches.

snapshot_timing: Producer received the snapshot request after its first custody edit.
